m: प्र-√ 1. पा P. -पिबति, (ind.p. -पाय, Pāṇ. vi, 4, 69), to begin to drink, drink, RV. &c. &c.; to imbibe (चक्षुषा, with the eye i.e. feast the eyes upon), MBh.

प्र-पा f. a place for supplying water, a place for watering cattle or a shed on the road-side containing a reservoir of water for travellers, fountain, cistern, well, AV. &c. &c. (cf. Pāṇ. iii, 3, 58, Vārtt. 4, Pat.)
a supply of water, affluent (of a tank &c.), L.
प्र-√ 3. पा P. -पाति, to protect, defend from (abl.), BhP.
a: प्रपा — 1 A place where water is distributed to travellers; व्याख्यास्थानान्यमलसलिला यस्य कूपाः प्रपाश्च Vikr. 18. 78. --2 A well, cistern; Ms. 8. 319. --3 A place for watering cattle. --4 A supply of water. --5 A draught. --Comp. --पालिका a woman who distributes water to travellers; Vikr. 1. 89; 13. 10. --वनं a cool grove.

k.v: चैत्यमायतनं तुल्ये वाजिशाला तु मन्दुरा। आवेशनं शिल्पिशाला प्रपा पानीयशालिका॥

a: प्रपाणिः — 1 The forepart of the hand. --2 The palm of the extended hand.

प्र-˚पाथ m. a road, way, L.
a: प्रपाथः — A road, way.

प्र-˚पाद see अ-प्रपाद.

m: प्रपादिक or प्रपा˚दीक, m. a peacock, L.
a: प्रपादिकः — A peacock.

प्र-पादुक &c. See above.

digestion, Car.
(prob.) a partic. part of the flesh of a victim, Kauś.
प्र-पाक See प्र- √ 2. पच्.

प्र-˚पालन n. guarding, protecting, protection, Cat.
a: प्रपालनं — Protecting, guarding.

a: प्रपालिन् — m. An epithet of Balarāma.

m: प्र-पा—मण्डप m. a shed with water for travellers, Vcar.
प्र-˚पान n. drinking, sipping, R.
the under part of a horse's upper lip (which he uses in drinking), Var. (v.l. ˚पाण).
a: प्रपानं — 1 Drinking. --2 The underpart of a horse's upper lip.

a: प्रपानकं — A kind of drink.

प्र-पा—पालिका f. a woman who distributes water to travellers, Vcar.

प्र-पा˚ताम्बु n. water falling from a rock, Rājat.

m: प्र-पात m. a partic. mode of flying, Pañcat.
springing forth, Var.
an attack, L.
starting off, setting out, departure, Kathās.
falling down, falling from (abl. or comp.) or into (loc. or comp.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
falling out (of teeth, hair &c.), Suśr.
discharge, emission, flow (of semen), VP.
letting fall (a glance on anything), Kum.
a steep rock, cliff, precipice, MBh.; Hariv. &c.
a steep bank or shore, L.
a cascade, waterfall, L.
प्र-पात &c. See प्र-√ पत्.
a: प्रपातः — 1 Going forth or away, departure. --2 Falling down or into, a fall; मनोरथानामतटप्रपातः Ś. 6. 9; Ku. 6. 57. --3 A sudden attack. --4 A cascade, waterfall, the place over which water falls down; R. 2. 26. --5 A bank, shore. --6 A precipice, steep rock. --7 Falling out or loss, as in केशप्रपात. --8 Emission, discharge, efflux, as in वीर्यप्रपात. --9 Throwing oneself down from a rock. --10 A particular mode of flight. --Comp. --अंबु n. water falling from a rock.

k.v: पाषाणप्रस्तरग्रावोपलाश्मानः शिला दृषत्. कूटोऽस्त्री शिखरं शृङ्गं प्रपातस्त्वतटो भृगुः॥

m: प्र-˚पातम् ind. falling down, MBh.
प्र-˚पातन n. (fr. Caus.) causing to fall, throwing down, R.
throwing, casting (अक्ष-प्˚, ‘c˚-dice’), Hariv.
a: प्रपातनं — Causing to fall, throwing down (on the ground).

m: प्र-˚पातिन् m. a rock, cliff, mountain, L.
a: प्रपातिन् — m. A precipitous mountain, cliff.

v: na॰ prapeva kAmapUrakaM vanam । kAmAraRye vanaBede SabdamAlA ।

a: प्रपॄ — {c9c} P. To fill up, complete. --Pass. To be filled or completed; be fulfilled.

a: प्रपीड् — {c10c} U. 1 To press, squeeze. --2 To torture, torment, harass, afflict. --3 To check, suppress, restrain.

m: प्र-˚पीडन n. pressing, squeezing, Suśr.
an astringent, ib.
a: प्रपीडनं — 1 Pressing, squeezing. --2 An astringent.

प्र-पीत mfn. swollen out, swollen up, distended, RV.
a: प्रपीत(न) — a. Swollen up, distended.

Hibiscus Mutabilis, Suśr.

प्र-˚पूजित mfn. honoured, respected, MBh.
प्र-˚पूरण mf(ई)n. filling up (oil, and) increasing (love), Cat.
the act of filling up, filling, putting in, inserting, injecting (with loc. or comp.), Suśr.
satiating, satisfying, Cat.

adorning, embellishing (of Indra's banner), Var.

m: प्र-˚पूरक mf(इका)n. filling up, fulfilling, satisfying, Kāvyād., Sch.
a: प्रपूरक — a. Fulfilling, satisfying.

प्र-˚पूरित mfn. filled up, completed, MBh.
a: प्रपूरित — p. p. Filled up.

v: pu॰ prakfzwaH pUrvagaH pUrvavarttI prA॰ sa॰ । sfzweH prAgvarttini 1 parameSvare “sadeva sOmyedamagra AsIdekamevAdvitIyamiti SruteH tasya taTAtvam । tadrUpeRa Dyeye 2 aSvinIkumAradvaye dvi॰ va॰ । BA॰ A॰ 3 a॰ aSvinIkumArastutiH ।
a: प्रपूर्वगः — 1 The Supreme being. --2 N. of the two Aśvins.

प्रपंचः — 1 Display, manifestation; रागप्रायः प्रपंचः K. 151. --2 Development, expansion, extension; Śi. 20. 44. --3 Amplification, expatiation, explanation, elucidation. --4 Prolixity, diffuseness, copiousness; अलं प्रपंचेन. --5 Manifoldness, diversity. --6 Heap, abundance, quantity. --7 An appearance, phenomenon. --8 Illusion, fraud. --9 The visible world or universe, which is illusory and the scene of manifold action. --10 Reciprocal false praise. --11 Opposition, inversion. --12 Analysis. --Comp. --बुद्धि a. cunning, deceitful. --वचनं a prolix discourse, diffuse talk.
प्रपंचक — a. 1 Displaying, showing. --2 Developing. --3 Explaining fully, amplifying, expounding in detail.
प्रपंचनं — 1 Display, development. --2 Copious exposition, detailed explanation or amplification.
प्रपंचयति — Den. P. 1 To show forth, display; प्रपंचय पंचमं Gīt. 10. --2 To expand, amplify, explain in detail, dwell or dilate upon, treat at length. --3 To cause to appear in a false light.
प्रपंचित — p. p. 1 Displayed. --2 Expanded, amplified. --3 Dilated upon, fully explained, expatiated upon. --4 Erring, mistaken. --5 Deceived, tricked.

m: प्र-पण m. (√ पण्) exchange, barter, AV.
a: प्रपणः — Ved. Barter, exchange.

m: प्र-√ पश् P. -पश्यति (ep. also Ā. ˚ते), to see before one's eyes, look at, observe, behold, RV. &c. &c.; to judge, discern, MBh.; to know, understand, R.; to regard as, take for (two acc.), MBh.
प्र-˚पश्यत् or प्र-˚पश्यमान, mfn. well-discerning, judicious, sensible, intelligent, MBh.
प्र-पथा (ifc. f. आ) a broad road or street, Kāṭh.; BhP.

m: प्र-˚पथिन् mfn. roaming on distant paths (superl. -तम), RV.
प्र-˚पथिन् m. N. of a man, ib.

a: प्रपथ्य — a. Ved. 1 Being in or on the road. --2 An epithet of Pūṣan.

a: प्रपठ् — {c1c} P. To repeat aloud. --Caus. To teach, explain, expound.

प्र-पञ्˚चास्य mf(आ)n. (prob.) having various faces, Hcat.

manifoldness, diversity, Kāv.; Śaṃk.; Pañcat.
amplification, prolixity, diffuseness, copiousness (in style; ˚चेन ind. and ˚च-तस् ind. diffusely, in detail), Hariv.; Hit.
manifestation of or form of (gen.), Hit.; Bhāṣāp.
appearance, phenomenon, Vcar.
(in phil.) the expansion of the universe, the visible world, Up.; Kap.; Sarvad.
(in rhet.) mutual false praise, Pratāp.
(in dram.) ludicrous dialogue, Sāh.
(in gram.) the repetition of an obscure rule in a clearer form, Pāṇ., Sch.
(said to be encl. after a finite verb g. गोत्रादि)
deceit, trick, fraud, error, L.
opposition, reversion, L.

represented in a false light, BhP.
erring, mistaken, W.
deceived, beguiled, W.

1. प्र-√ 2. पद् Ā. -पद्यते (ep. also P.), to fall or drop down from (abl.), throw one's self down (at a person's feet), MBh.; to go forwards set out for, resort to, arrive at, attain, enter (with acc., rarely loc.), AV. &c. &c.; to fly to for succour, take refuge with (acc.), TS. &c. &c.; to fall upon, attack, assail, RV.; AV.; to come to a partic. state or condition, incur, undergo (acc.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.; (with an adv. in सात्), to become, e.g. सर्पसात् प्र-√ पद्, to bec˚ a serpent, Bhaṭṭ.; to obtain, gain (पतिम्, ‘as husband’), partake of, share in (acc.), ib.; to adopt or embrace (a doctrine), Rājat.; to undertake, commence, begin, do, MBh.; Kāv.; to form (a judgement), MBh.; to assume (a form), Kathās.; to enjoy (pleasure), R.; to take to (dat.), Hariv.; to come on, approach, appear, AV.; R.; Hariv.; to take effect, succeed, MBh.; to turn out (अन्यथा, ‘differently’ i.e. without any effect or consequence), Hariv.; to admit (a claim), R. : Caus. -पादयति, ˚ते, to cause to enter, introduce into (acc. or loc.), Br. : Desid. P. पित्सति, to wish to enter, ŚBr.; Ā. -पित्सते (cf. Pāṇ. vii, 4, 54), to be going to incur or undertake, Daś.
2. प्र-पद् f. away, AitBr.
N. of partic. sacred texts, Br.; GṛŚrS.
3. प्र-पद् f. (fr. 3. पद्) the fore part of the foot, AV.
a: प्रपद् — {c4c} A. 1 To enter upon, set forward, set foot in. --2 (a) To go to or towards, approach, resort or attain to, reach; तां जन्मने शैलवधूं प्रपेदे Ku. 1. 21; (क्षितीशं) कौत्सः प्रपेदे वरतंतुशिष्यः R. 5. 1; Bk. 4. 1; Ki. 1. 9; 11. 16; R. 8. 11. (b) To take shelter or refuge with, flee to for safety, submit; शरणार्थमन्यां कथं प्रपत्स्ये त्वयि दीप्यमाने R. 14. 64. --3 To go or come to a particular state, arrive at, attain to, arrive at or be in a particular condition; रेणुः प्रपेदे पथि पंकभावं R. 16. 30; मुहूर्तकर्णोत्पलतां प्रपेदे Ku. 7. 81; बाल्यात्परं साथ वयः प्रपेदे Ku. 1. 31; 5. 24; ईदृशीमवस्थां प्रपन्नोस्मि Ś. 5: ऋषिनिकरौरिति संशयः प्रपेदे Bv. 4. 33; Amaru. 27. --4 To get, find, secure, obtain, attain to; partake of share in; सहकार न प्रपेदे मधुपेन भवत्समं जगति Bv. 1. 21; कांतं वपुर्व्योमचरं प्रपेदे R. 5. 51. --5 To behave or act towards, deal with; किं प्रपद्यते वैदर्भः M. 1 ‘what does he propose to do’; पश्यामो मयि किं प्रपद्यते Amaru. 20. --6 To admit, allow, agree or consent to; Y. 2. 40. --7 To draw near, come on, approach (as time &c.). --8 To be going on, to proceed. --9 To take effect, thrive, prosper. --10 To throw oneself down, fall down (at another's feet). --11 Ved. To attack, assault.

प्रपदीन w.r. for आ-प्रपदीन, q.v.

प्र-˚पदन n. entering, entrance into (comp.), ĀśvGṛ.; Vait.
access, approach, ŚBr.; ChUp.
a: प्रपदनं — Entrance.

a: प्रपलायित — a. 1 Run away. --2 Routed, defeated.

effecting, producing, W.
poor, distressed, ib.

a: प्रपृष्ठ — a. Having a prominent back.

a: प्रपितृव्यः — A paternal grand-uncle.

m: प्र-˚पित्सु mfn. (fr. Desid.) wishing to fall or throw one's self down, Śiś.
